scene: The wooden carousel spins into a glowing vortex.
picture: On a level ground line, the tall Latino man in his straw hat and red poncho sits atop a painted wooden horse in the centre. The carousel whirls with neon sparkles. A stationary exit platform sits on the far left, a swinging rope hangs up high, and a mirror door glows on the far right.
shown: A thick braided rope swinging wildly up high above the spinning deck.
A wooden disembarking platform waiting stationary on the far left.
A swirling magenta mirror door installed on the far right.
